_comment: Per-agent model configuration. Edit freely; changes take effect on next server start (or use PUT /api/runtime/agent-models for hot reload).

presets._comment: Predefined model aliases — useful for fast experimentation. Reference by setting the agent entry to one of these strings prefixed with 'preset:' (see notes).

notes._comment: Free-form documentation block. Each model you put above should match a model listed in your opencode.json 'provider' section.
notes.custom-saas/minimax-MiniMax-M3-cp: Default MiniMax M3 — multimodal (image/video), strong reasoning, good for coding + review + vision.
notes.custom-saas/qwen-3.6-saas: Qwen 3.6 via custom-saas gateway — balanced cost/quality. Used by Analyst + Writer for analysis & prose.
notes.custom-saas/glm-5-saas: GLM 5 via custom-saas — deep reasoning, slower but more careful.
notes.comagic/qwen3.6-flash-saas: Qwen 3.6 flash via Comagic — fastest, cheapest. Used by Scout + Echo.
notes.comagic/kimi-k2.6-saas: Kimi K2.6 — long-context friendly, good for large code review tasks.
notes.comagic/deepseek-v4-pro-saas: DeepSeek V4 Pro — strong code generation, alternative to MiniMax M3.
notes.comagic/saas-minimax: Legacy minimax via Comagic gateway — kept for compat.
selection_tips: Atlas (orchestrator): fast/balanced is fine — it doesn't think deeply, just routes. preset:fast works.
Forge (implementer): needs strong code generation — minimax-MiniMax-M3-cp or deepseek-v4-pro-saas.
Lens (reviewer): needs careful reading — minimax-MiniMax-M3-cp or kimi-k2.6 (long context).
Echo (support + fallback): fast is fine — preset:fast.
Scout (research): fast — reads many sources, summarize. preset:fast.
Analyst (analysis): balanced — needs careful reasoning. qwen-3.6-saas.
Writer (prose): balanced — needs style awareness. qwen-3.6-saas.
Archivist (KB): deep — needs to extract evergreen patterns carefully. minimax-MiniMax-M3-cp or preset:deep.
Vis (vision): MUST be multimodal model — minimax-MiniMax-M3-cp.
